versions.description_html:
Learn what Power Platform governance really means. Discover environments, data policies, ownership, and how to control apps without killing innovation.

Somewhere in your organization, an app is running that nobody remembers building. It still works, so nobody asks.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Governance Really Means
  • Why Anyone Bothers
  • Environments Are Just Rooms
  • Data Policies: The Rules of the Road
  • Who Actually Owns This
  • Watching What Happens
  • Control Without Killing Freedom
  • The Short Version

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Power Platform Governance Without Killing Innovation: Security, DLP, Environments & Citizen Development with Michael Roth [MVP]
  • Power Platform Governance: From Shadow IT to Secure Scale
  • More Power Platform episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Power Platform: the most-listened episodes
